sections.heading: C — License eligibility, identity and application
sections.markdown:
## C — License eligibility, identity and application

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A02
Applicants for a federally compliant license or identification card must provide documents establishing identity, lawful U.S. status, birth date, Social Security number and primary home address. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A02
The DMV must verify the source documents an applicant presents. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A02
A compliant Delaware license or identification card displays a gold star at its upper-right corner. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A02
A noncompliant Delaware license or identification card displays the wording Not for Federal ID along its top margin. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A03
A person driving a motor vehicle on Delaware public roads must possess and carry a driver license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A03
A new bona fide Delaware resident must obtain a Delaware license within 60 days. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A03
Temporary highway operation of road rollers, road machinery or farm implements does not require a Delaware driver license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A03
A nonresident older than 16 may drive using a current home-state or home-country license carried in the vehicle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A03
An active-duty U.S. Armed Forces member or dependent may use a valid license issued by the state of domicile. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A03
An applicant cannot receive a license before reaching the minimum age for that license or endorsement. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A03
An applicant younger than 18 must complete a Delaware Department of Education approved driver education course. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A03
An applicant younger than 18 must obtain the required consent signature on the application. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A03
Suspension or revocation of driving privileges in any jurisdiction prevents issuance of a Delaware license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A03
A license applicant must be a bona fide Delaware resident. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A03
An applicant must understand English-language road signs to qualify for a license. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A03
An applicant must have the physical and mental ability to drive safely. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A03
For a central-nervous-system disease causing loss of consciousness, the applicant must provide a licensed practitioner’s written certification that the condition is controlled sufficiently for safe driving. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A03
A person unable to establish lawful U.S. presence must meet Driving Privilege Card requirements to qualify through that path. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F19 | anchor: A03
Conflicting personal information held by other agencies can prevent license issuance. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0018]

FACT_ID: sec02-F20 | anchor: A04
A license application must be made in person at a Delaware DMV office. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-F21 | anchor: A04
At initial licensing and renewal, noncitizens must present original immigration documents so the DMV can verify lawful status and authorized stay. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-F22 | anchor: A04
An applicant whose immigration or passport documents are invalid or expired is ineligible for a regular Delaware license or identification card but may qualify for a Driving Privilege Card. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0019]

FACT_ID: sec02-F23 | anchor: A05
For noncitizens, the expiration of a Delaware license or identification card cannot extend past the person’s authorized U.S. stay. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F24 | anchor: A05
The DMV uses SAVE to verify a noncitizen’s immigration status and authorized U.S. stay electronically. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F25 | anchor: A05
When immigration records describe a temporary applicant’s stay as indefinite or duration of status, the handbook assigns a license expiration after one year. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F26 | anchor: A05
A temporary nonimmigrant applicant whose record cannot be verified through SAVE must resolve the mismatch through USCIS before DMV can issue the document. [A05]
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0020]

FACT_ID: sec02-F27 | anchor: A06
A driver-license applicant must sign the application and surrender agreement and answer their questions. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F28 | anchor: A06
An applicant holding another state’s driver license or identification card must surrender that document. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F29 | anchor: A06
An applicant eligible for a Social Security number must provide proof of that number. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F30 | anchor: A06
Each driver must pass a vision screening. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F31 | anchor: A06
Every driver-license applicant is subject to written and road-skills examinations. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F32 | anchor: A06
The identification-document requirements call for a primary document and a secondary document. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F33 | anchor: A06
The primary identity document must show the applicant’s full name and birth date and permit verification with its issuing agency. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F34 | anchor: A06
An applicant must provide two proofs of Delaware residence. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F35 | anchor: A06
Noncitizen applicants must provide proof of lawful presence in the United States. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F36 | anchor: A06
False information on a signed application can lead to suspension of the resulting driver license. [A06]
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-F37 | anchor: A07
Photocopied, expired or altered identity and lawful-presence documents are unacceptable. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F38 | anchor: A07
Names must match across the documents an applicant presents. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F39 | anchor: A07
A U.S. birth certificate used as identity proof must be an original or certified copy issued by the vital-statistics or state-health authority and carry a raised seal. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-F40 | anchor: A07
Wallet birth cards and hospital birth announcements or records are unacceptable substitutes for the required birth certificate. [A07]
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0022]

Misconceptions: A document authorizing driving does not automatically establish federally compliant identification.
Mnemonics: Use “path, proof, matching names” as an authored cue for reviewing the cited application requirements.
Glossary: A compliant card is the identification category marked with the gold star; a Driving Privilege Card has driving-only scope.
Dynamic facts: Provider appointment links, contact details and changeable consular-card lists need current confirmation rather than stable memorization.

items.skill: Match an application path to its required evidence
items.why: The regular-license and Driving Privilege Card paths have different eligibility and document rules.

items.skill: Distinguish compliant identification and driving authority
items.why: The handbook distinguishes federal identification from state driving permission.

corpus_stability.reason: Working assessment from a single dated July edition and no indication of multiple yearly revisions in the selected pages; revision cadence has not been independently confirmed.
